name: Husqvarna 330iKP
blurb: Battery pole saw. 10″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, chain S93G X-Cut, from the 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 330iKP is listed as a residential battery pole saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) pairs a 10″ laminate bar 596298540 with chain S93G X-Cut 597469540: 3/8″ Mini, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, 5/32″ file. The 115iPT4 uses that same bar part with chain H37, not S93G. Match the chain name on the box to the row, not the bar length alone.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 10″ setup with bar Laminate 596298540 and chain S93G X-Cut 597469540.
